events.title: US midterm elections — Democrats win Congress
events.why_it_matters: Democratic control of both chambers blocks Trump's legislative agenda and signals gridlock, but may reduce tariff-escalation risk.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Democrats pursue investigations, block tariffs, or force spending concessions.

events.title: OPEC+ holds December oil production steady
events.why_it_matters: Keeping output unchanged maintains supply amid demand concerns, capping oil price upside.
events.what_to_watch: Next meeting Nov 29; compliance and demand signals.

events.title: South Korea top court upholds Broadcom antitrust fine
events.why_it_matters: Reinforces antitrust risk for US chipmakers in Korea; minor financial impact but precedent-setting.
events.what_to_watch: Other jurisdictions' antitrust actions against Broadcom.

events.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump bid to set aside California ballots
events.why_it_matters: Reduces election-litigation risk, supporting a smooth transfer of power and lowering political uncertainty.
events.what_to_watch: Any further legal challenges to election results.

events.title: LA/Long Beach port watchmen strike deadline
events.why_it_matters: A strike at the largest US port complex would disrupt trans-Pacific trade and supply chains.
events.what_to_watch: Whether a deal is reached before the 5pm PT deadline.

events.title: Bank of England rate decision
events.why_it_matters: Expected 25bp hike to 4.00%, the first of 2026, as inflation persists; signals global hawkish tilt.
events.what_to_watch: Vote split and guidance on further hikes.

events.title: US nonfarm payrolls for October
events.why_it_matters: Key labour data before the December FOMC; consensus +50k, unemployment 4.2%.
events.what_to_watch: Wage growth and revisions; any surprise shifts December hike odds.

events.title: China October trade data
events.why_it_matters: Exports have been strong; data will show momentum amid the tariff truce.
events.what_to_watch: Export growth to the US and EU; import volumes.

events.title: China October CPI
events.why_it_matters: Inflation near 0.9%; a weak print reinforces deflation fears and stimulus expectations.

events.title: US October CPI
events.why_it_matters: Last major inflation reading before the December FOMC; consensus 3.7% y/y, could determine a hike.

events.title: Russia-Ukraine-US peace talks in Abu Dhabi
events.why_it_matters: A ceasefire framework could ease energy and commodity supply risks.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Russia agrees to a ceasefire; energy market reaction.

events.title: US-China tariff truce expiration
events.why_it_matters: The 90-day suspension of 24% reciprocal tariffs expires; failure to extend would raise tariffs and disrupt trade.
events.what_to_watch: USTR announcement; whether the truce is extended.

events.title: Applied Materials FQ4 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Semiconductor equipment bellwether; AI capex demand in focus.
events.what_to_watch: Guidance on wafer fab equipment spending.

events.title: Cisco FQ1 2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Networking and AI infrastructure demand read.

events.title: US October PPI
events.why_it_matters: Pipeline inflation gauge after September's upside surprise.

events.title: Eurozone Q3 GDP flash estimate
events.why_it_matters: Q3 growth expected 0.4% q/q; resilience supports an ECB pause.

events.title: Japan Q3 GDP first preliminary
events.why_it_matters: Weak consumption may complicate the BoJ hike path; a contraction would be dovish.

events.title: China October retail sales and industrial production
events.why_it_matters: Retail sales growth near 1%; industrial production slowing; shows stimulus effectiveness.
events.what_to_watch: Retail sales y/y and property investment.

events.title: Anthropic IPO on Nasdaq
events.why_it_matters: Potential record IPO ($1.5-2T valuation) could be a sentiment wildcard for the AI trade.
events.what_to_watch: Pricing and first-day pop; demand for AI stocks.

events.title: Nvidia Q3 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Largest AI bellwether; guidance will determine AI trade direction after the recent selloff.
events.what_to_watch: Data center revenue and Q4 guidance.

events.title: Home Depot Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Housing-market bellwether; weak results signal residential investment stress.

events.title: Disney FQ4 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Streaming profitability and theme-park demand amid consumer pressure.
events.what_to_watch: Disney+ subscriber growth and parks revenue.

events.title: Target Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Consumer discretionary bellwether; signals spending strain.

events.title: Palo Alto Networks FQ1 2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Cybersecurity spending trend; AI-driven demand.

events.title: Walmart Q3 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Largest US retailer; consumer health gauge.
events.what_to_watch: US comp sales and grocery inflation.

events.title: Intuit FQ1 2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Small business and consumer finance software demand.

events.title: FOMC October meeting minutes
events.why_it_matters: Details of the hawkish hold; may reveal the December hike debate.

events.title: UK October CPI
events.why_it_matters: Inflation data after the BoE hike; informs the future path.

events.title: Eurozone October CPI final
events.why_it_matters: Confirms the inflation trend amid energy price pressures.

events.title: Congress returns for lame-duck session
events.why_it_matters: Must address government funding before the Dec 11 deadline; Democratic control may reshape priorities.

events.title: Fed officials speeches
events.why_it_matters: Speeches may signal December hike intentions after the hawkish hold.

events.title: Gaza ceasefire violations continue
events.why_it_matters: Ongoing violations keep a geopolitical risk premium in oil.

events.title: Atlantic hurricane season late-season development
events.why_it_matters: A late-season storm could disrupt Gulf energy production and insurers.

top_risks: US CPI upside surprise forces a December Fed hike, pressuring equities and bonds.
Nvidia earnings disappointment reignites the AI/semiconductor selloff.
US-China tariff truce expires on Nov 10, raising tariffs and disrupting trade.
Russia-Ukraine talks fail, keeping energy risk premium elevated.
LA/Long Beach port strike disrupts trans-Pacific supply chains.
top_opportunities: Midterm gridlock reduces regulatory and tariff-escalation risk, supporting risk assets.
Anthropic IPO could boost AI sentiment and draw capital into tech.
Weak China data raises stimulus expectations, lifting commodities and China-exposed sectors.
BoE hike is largely priced in; sterling and UK banks may rally on relief.
Resilient retail earnings (Walmart, Target) could ease consumer slowdown fears.
summary: Markets enter the post-midterm period with a Democratic Congress, a hawkish Fed on hold, and critical inflation and mega-cap tech earnings in the next fortnight. The main tension is between a market pricing a benign pause and data that could force a December hike, while US-China tariff expiry and AI earnings are key swing factors.
